metadata.title: How AI-Powered Scams Are Wiping Out Retirees’ Savings—and How to Protect Yourself<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
AI Is Turbocharging Romance Scams and Draining Retirement Savings
Artificial intelligence is making it easier to be an online swindler. Everyone is at risk, particularly the elderly.
Pamela, a 63-year-old New Englander, joined an online dating platform after her daughter suggested she might meet someone to bring to her wedding the following year. After a couple months, Pamela found a message from a wholesome-looking man who said all the right things.
